title: A real MIT bot module that reads the signing key and the RPC URL from environment variables (clean control, attributed)

proof.python:
s = open('common_excerpt.js').read()
assert 'process.env["PRIVATE_KEY_" + mode]' in s and 'process.env["RPC_URL_" + network.toUpperCase()]' in s and 'MIT License' in s and '6a94b77c7f4cc30da67c6680258922559a12587e' in s
import re
assert not re.search(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}', s) and not re.search(r'/v2/[0-9a-zA-Z]{20,}', s)

notes: common.js: MIT, github.com/revert-finance/liquidator-js @ 6a94b77c; attribution kept in the file header.
